from pathlib import Path
import os,sys,subprocess,json,hashlib,array
r=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'tests'))
import f32,common
common.EXE=str(r/'candidate-cli.exe')
if '--history-only' not in sys.argv: assert f32.run()
rows=[]
for heads,kv,hd in [(2,1,42),(4,2,42),(4,4,10)]:
 f32.CONFIG['attention.key_length']=hd
 weights=f32.tensors(False)
 expanded=[]
 for name,hfname,shape,values in weights:
  factor=1
  if name.endswith('attn_q.weight'): factor=heads//2; shape=[37,heads*hd]
  elif name.endswith(('attn_k.weight','attn_v.weight')): factor=kv; shape=[37,kv*hd]
  elif name.endswith('attn_output.weight'): factor=heads//2; shape=[heads*hd,37]
  expanded_values = [v * (1.0 - 0.125 * copy) + 0.00390625 * copy for copy in range(factor) for v in values]
  expanded.append((name,hfname,shape,expanded_values))
 f32.CONFIG.update({'attention.head_count':heads,'attention.head_count_kv':kv,'context_length':67})
 model=r/f'history-{heads}-{kv}-{hd}.gguf'
 f32.write_model(model,expanded)
 outputs=[]
 for arm in ('control','candidate'):
  path=r/f'history-{heads}-{kv}-{hd}-{arm}.f32'
  p=subprocess.run([str(r/f'{arm}-history.exe'),str(model),str(path)],capture_output=True,text=True)
  (r/f'{path.stem}.log').write_text(p.stdout+p.stderr)
  p.check_returncode(); print(arm,heads,kv,hd,p.stdout.strip(),flush=True)
  outputs.append(path.read_bytes())
 assert outputs[0]==outputs[1], 'full history vectors differ'
 rows.append(dict(heads=heads,kv_heads=kv,head_width=hd,**json.loads(p.stdout),sha256=hashlib.sha256(outputs[0]).hexdigest(),exact=True))
(r/'history-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
print('History full vectors byte-identical; independent tiny HF fixture passed.',flush=True)
